description: [experimental] Builds a 12-channel pitch-class chroma vector (chroma_0..chroma_11) from an audio bus via FFT bin → pitch-class fold. Outputs a Null CHOP ready for bind_to_channel. Shares audioSource convention with create_transient_reactive / create_energy_reactive.

audioSource.description: Optional path to an existing CHOP to use as audio input. If omitted, an internal Audio Device In CHOP is created (may prompt for macOS microphone permission).

fftSize.description: FFT size for the Audio Spectrum CHOP.

smoothing.description: Temporal smoothing on chroma vector (0 = raw, 1 = frozen). Maps to Filter CHOP width.

name: create_chroma_reactive
title: Create Chroma Reactive (experimental)
